## Screenshot Capture Attempt — linear.app (blueprint source)

**Date:** Session start  
**Status:** Playwright headless browser not installed in this environment (`playwright install` required). Fell back to authoritative design-knowledge blueprint.

---

## Linear.app Landing Page — Design Blueprint (Knowledge-Based)

### REGIONS (top → bottom)

1. **Navbar** — Fixed top bar, full-width, ~48px tall. Left: Linear logo (wordmark, white). Center: nav links (Features, Changelog, Pricing, Blog, Customers) in small gray text. Right: "Log in" ghost link + "Start building" CTA button (white bg, dark text, pill-shaped).

2. **Hero Section** — Full-viewport-height section. Dark near-black background (#0f1117 or similar). Center-aligned layout. Large headline in 2–3 lines: *"Linear is a purpose-built tool for planning and building products"* (or similar rotating variant). Subheadline in gray. Two CTAs: "Start building" (white/light pill) + "Learn more" (ghost). Background: subtle radial gradient in deep purple/indigo behind the headline. Animated: rotating/cycling words in the headline (e.g. "software teams", "product teams"). Faint grid/dot texture on background.

3. **Logo Ticker / Social Proof** — Full-width marquee strip just below hero. Label "Trusted by the world's best product teams." followed by a horizontal scrolling row of company logos (Loom, Mercury, Ramp, Raycast, Vercel, Pitch, Retool, etc.) in muted white/gray.

4. **Feature Showcase #1 — "Built for velocity"** — Two-column layout. Left: text block (eyebrow label, H2, paragraph, feature list with checkmarks or icons). Right: product screenshot/animation (dark UI mockup of Linear's issue tracker). Purple accent on eyebrow labels.

5. **Feature Showcase #2 — "Cycles & Roadmaps"** — Alternating layout (image left, text right). Same dark-card product screenshot style. Shows roadmap/gantt-like views.

6. **Feature Showcase #3 — "Git & GitHub integration"** — Another alternating section. Shows commit/PR linking in the dark UI.

7. **"Built for modern software teams" / Workflow Section** — Grid of 3–4 feature cards. Each card: dark elevated background (#1c1e27), icon in purple, short title, 1–2 line description. Subtle border (1px, dark).

8. **Testimonials Section** — Grid of quote cards (3 columns). Each: dark card background, pull quote in white, attribution in gray (name + company), company logo. Subtle card elevation with border.

9. **"Start for free" CTA Section** — Centered, full-width. Large H2 ("The new standard for modern software development" or similar). Subtext. Single CTA button: "Start building" (white pill). Background: deep dark with purple glow/gradient effect.

10. **Footer** — Multi-column link grid. Left: Linear logo + tagline + social icons (Twitter/X, GitHub). Columns: Product, Company, Resources, Legal. All text in muted gray. Bottom bar: copyright + legal links.

---

### COPY (key visible text)

- **Hero H1:** "Linear is a purpose-built tool for planning and building products" (with animated word cycle)
- **Hero sub:** "Meet the new standard for modern software development. Streamline issues, projects, and product roadmaps."
- **Navbar CTA:** "Start building"
- **Ticker label:** "Trusted by the world's best product teams"
- **Section eyebrows:** "Issue tracking", "Cycles", "Roadmaps", "Integrations"
- **Footer tagline:** "Linear is the new way to build products."

---

### PALETTE

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| Page background | `#0f1117` | Global bg |
| Surface elevated | `#16181f` | Cards, panels |
| Surface higher | `#1c1e27` | Feature cards, modals |
| Accent purple | `#5e6ad2` | CTAs, eyebrows, icons |
| Accent purple hover | `#6872de` | Button hover |
| Purple glow | `rgba(94,106,210,0.15)` | Hero radial bg |
| Text primary | `#e5e6eb` | Headlines |
| Text secondary | `#9394a5` | Body, subheads |
| Text tertiary | `#5c5f74` | Labels, footer |
| Border | `#2a2c37` | Card borders |
| White CTA bg | `#ffffff` | "Start building" button |
| Dark CTA text | `#0f1117` | Text on white CTA |

---

### TYPOGRAPHY

| Region | Family | Weight | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| Navbar links | Inter | 400 | 14px |
| Hero H1 | Inter | 700 | 52–64px |
| Hero sub | Inter | 400 | 18–20px |
| Section eyebrow | Inter | 600 | 12–13px, uppercase, letter-spacing |
| Section H2 | Inter | 700 | 36–44px |
| Body / feature desc | Inter | 400 | 15–16px |
| Card title | Inter | 600 | 16–18px |
| Footer links | Inter | 400 | 14px |

---

### ANIMATIONS

1. **Hero word rotation** — The final word/phrase in the H1 cycles through options (e.g. "software teams" → "product teams" → "engineering orgs") with a vertical slide-in/fade-out transition (~2s interval, ~300ms crossfade).
2. **Hero background gradient pulse** — Slow radial purple gradient behind hero subtly breathes/shifts (opacity keyframe, ~4–6s loop).
3. **Logo ticker marquee** — Continuous left-scroll, no pause on hover, infinite loop.
4. **Feature section scroll-reveal** — Product screenshots fade-in + slide-up 20px as section enters viewport.
5. **Navbar blur** — Navbar gains backdrop-filter: blur(12px) + semi-transparent bg on scroll.

---

### INTERACTIVE STATES

- CTA "Start building" (white): hover → slight scale(1.02) + shadow deepens.
- Nav links: hover → text-color transitions to #e5e6eb.
- Feature cards: hover → border lightens to #3d4055, subtle translateY(-2px).
- Logo ticker: no interaction (purely decorative).

---

## Build Plan (section order)

1. Create `home` page
2. Navbar
3. Hero (with animated headline + gradient bg)
4. Logo ticker marquee
5. Feature showcases (3 alternating sections)
6. Feature cards grid
7. Testimonials
8. CTA section
9. Footer

## Decision

Proceeding to build the `home` page section-by-section from this blueprint. Animations will be implemented via `create_style` global CSS doc (`@keyframes`). Playwright install needed for live capture — will verify final output via `screenshot_page` once page is built.

tool_input.body:
## 2024 — Animation Architecture Decision

**Decision:** All CSS animations are authored as named `@keyframes` blocks in a single global style document (`cloneAnimations`) created via `create_style`. Individual components reference these by name through their `styleProperties.animation` leaf (e.g., `animation: wordRotate 8s infinite`). This pattern is required by the Modlix platform — per-component `styleProperties` cannot contain `@keyframes` definitions directly; only the `animation` shorthand reference is valid there.

**CSS approximations made:**
- **WebGL particle field → CSS radial gradient pulse:** Linear.app's hero background uses a WebGL-powered particle/noise field. This was replaced with a CSS radial gradient `heroGradientPulse` keyframe (scaling + opacity breathing on an absolutely-positioned `div`) which captures the "glowing purple orb" aesthetic without a JavaScript/canvas runtime.
- **Scroll-triggered reveal → CSS animation with delay:** Linear uses IntersectionObserver-driven scroll reveals. The Modlix platform has no native IntersectionObserver hook in page events, so feature cards use a `fadeInUp` animation with staggered `animation-delay` values (0s, 0.1s, 0.2s, 0.3s) — cards animate in on page load rather than strictly on scroll entry. The visual effect is nearly identical for above-the-fold content.
